'''Gladius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Gladius was present in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with a group of Rodian [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]], [[Warlord/Legends|warchiefs]], [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and [[Medic/Legends|medics]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gladius appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
